color.note: Ink and white do most of the work. Doefin Blue marks the one thing to look at. Up, down and caution mean only gain, loss and warning. Dark is the brand's home; light is for documents, decks and print.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Doefin ink. The brand's dark ground, and the text colour on light grounds. The same in both themes: use it for logo plates, social cards and title slides that are always dark.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Doefin Blue, the one accent. Use it for the single thing to look at: a large number, a chart's main line, one block of colour. As text, only at 24px and up (or bold 19px and up). White on blue is 4.1:1, so the same size rule applies. Buttons use `action`; links use `link`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The wordmark and text on `ink` and `blue` plates.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: The wordmark's colour on `bg`: white in dark, ink in light. Use it when the logo sits on the page ground rather than on a plate.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. `ink` in dark; a cool off-white in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and chart frames on `bg`. Edge them with `line`, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Summary panels, table header rows, quote and code blocks.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected tab, active row, current step. Put `text` on it. In dark, `text-muted` is only 4.4:1 here, so don't use it on `selected`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, panel edges, chart gridlines. Decorative only, so it never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders people must see: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons. 3.1:1 or more on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-alt` and `selected`. 9.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, dates, captions and source lines on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (5.8:1 or more). One grey replaces the old pair, #838EA7 and #99A2B5: the lighter one keeps more contrast on every dark panel.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and inline actions on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button, with `on-action` text (5.4:1). One primary button per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover. White text on it is 4.9:1.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` and `action-hover`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px gap. 4.3:1 or more on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Gains only: a position or a price that went up. Always with a + sign or an up arrow. Text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Losses and errors only. Always with a minus sign, a down arrow or an error message. Text on `bg` and `surface` (4.6:1 or more). Never decoration: no orange eyebrows or icons.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings and the Illustrative badge. Use it as a fill with `on-caution` text (10.3:1).

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on `caution`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The main series in a chart: our data, our forecast. With `chart-2` it passes the colour-blind and contrast checks on `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: One comparison series, used only when a second series needs its own colour. Label both series on the chart.

tokens.name: chart-context
tokens.usage: Everything else in a chart: other sources, history, benchmarks. Charts sit on `surface`, where this is 3:1 or more.

tokens.name: chart-band
tokens.usage: The range around a forecast. State the same range in numbers in the caption.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Manrope 700 to 800 with tight tracking, in sentence case. Manrope has no italic.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Title slides, social cards and the one big statement on a page. Not in the app.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Difficulty rose 5.92% at block 971,712. For the same machines, that is about 5.6% fewer coins.
styles.usage: Anything longer than a paragraph: articles, research, docs. Keep lines under `measure`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each market asks one question: will difficulty be at or above a set level at a set block?
styles.usage: Interface text in the app and on the website.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, source lines, footnotes and the disclaimer, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, column heads and badge text. Always set in capitals.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Every figure uses tabular numerals so digits line up.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one number on a social card or a slide.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key figures on pages and in emails.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Wallet and contract addresses, transaction hashes. Never for figures.

spacing.note: A 4px base, on the same steps as Tailwind, which the website uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and chips; between a figure and its unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The side gutter on phones; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Above and below a page hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and chart frames.

tokens.name: radius-header
tokens.usage: Large header plates and hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Gain and loss chips.

shadow.note: Space first, a hairline second, a shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and tooltips. Never on cards.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The widest a block of reading text gets.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: The widest the page content gets.

tokens.name: slant
tokens.usage: The wordmark's slant. The only angle for slanted shapes and the letterform device.
